s1.syndrome_frame: Widespread skin condition with progressive worsening and characteristic plaques
salient_findings: Widespread polycyclic serpiginous, erythematous plaques with a double-edged scale
key_facts: The patient is a 32-year-old woman
The skin condition has progressively worsened
The condition involves 90% of her body surface area (BSA)
Polycyclic serpiginous, erythematous plaques are present on the trunk and extremities
The plaques involve 30% of the body surface area (BSA)
Eyebrow hairs are sparse and less than 5 mm long
Scalp hairs are coarse and brittle
Skin biopsy showed psoriasiform epidermal hyperplasia with spongiosis
Trichography showed nodal swelling, with invagination of the distal hair into the proximal end

shortlist.label: Pityriasis rubra pilaris
shortlist.why_kept: Characterized by widespread erythematous plaques and palmoplantar keratoderma, matching the patient's skin condition

shortlist.label: Psoriasis vulgaris
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of psoriasiform epidermal hyperplasia with spongiosis on skin biopsy and characteristic plaques

shortlist.label: Erythroderma
shortlist.why_kept: Involvement of 90% of the body surface area and progressive worsening of the skin condition

shortlist.label: Exfoliative dermatitis
shortlist.why_kept: Similar presentation to erythroderma, with widespread skin involvement and scaling

shortlist.label: Ichthyosis vulgaris
shortlist.why_kept: Coarse and brittle scalp hairs and sparse eyebrow hairs, suggesting a possible underlying ichthyotic condition

raw.rationale: The presence of widespread polycyclic serpiginous, erythematous plaques with a double-edged scale, sparse and short eyebrow hairs, and coarse and brittle scalp hairs, along with skin biopsy showing psoriasiform epidermal hyperplasia with spongiosis, are characteristic features of Pityriasis rubra pilaris.

rejected.label: Psoriasis vulgaris
rejected.why: While the skin biopsy shows psoriasiform epidermal hyperplasia, the clinical presentation and trichography findings are more suggestive of Pityriasis rubra pilaris.

rejected.label: Erythroderma
rejected.why: Erythroderma is a more generalized condition involving the entire body surface area, but the specific plaque morphology and hair findings in this case are more characteristic of Pityriasis rubra pilaris.

rejected.label: Exfoliative dermatitis
rejected.why: Exfoliative dermatitis typically presents with more widespread scaling and erythema, but the specific findings of polycyclic serpiginous plaques and hair abnormalities are not typical of this condition.

rejected.label: Ichthyosis vulgaris
rejected.why: Ichthyosis vulgaris is a condition characterized by dry, scaly skin, but it does not typically present with the specific plaque morphology or hair findings seen in this case.
